issue.title: MVP PoC mobile companion app
issue.body:
Goal: Produce a MVP PoC mobile companion app to fluent web.

The tasks that should be accomplished are:
- [x] Setup local development environment
    - [x] Can you build the app?
    - [x] Can you run the app in an emulator?
- [x] Scaffold a basic PoC application
    - [x] Remove boilerplate code - (movie related demo code)
    - [x] Update Project Identity
        - [x] Update `app.json`: Change `name` to "Fluent", update `slug`, `scheme`
        - [x] Update bundle identifiers:
            - iOS: `com.eten.fluent` (or preferred ID)
            - Android: `com.eten.fluent`
        - [x] Update `package.json`: Change `name` to `fluent-mobile`
        - [x] Update `README.md` with correct app description and setup instructions 
    - [x] Branding and themes: according to tickets
    - [x] Basic navigation - according to tickets
    - [x] Create Fluent web API client
    - [x] Sqlite - will be used for offline, on-device storage - use `libsql` or similar
    - [x] Audio: - according to tickets
        - [x] record audio
        - [x] playback audio
        - [x] editing audio: TBD
     - [x] CI/CD pipeline - Github Actions

The same best-practices for git workflows apply.

Refer to the [Langquest](https://github.com/genesis-ai-dev/langquest) project for inspiration. They are using a very similar tech stack that could provide ideas and insights.

PR reviews will be more relaxed as this is a PoC. That does not mean we should produce garbage code. Follow engineering best-practices.

Create Dev task tickets as-needed to track progress.

Recommended application architecture is in [the docs](https://github.com/eten-tech-foundation/fluent-mobile/blob/main/docs/architecture.md).
